title: Demo — routing, AMD, compliant texting
planted: rep commitment: SOC2 + TCPA one-pager by friday

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Rahul, thanks for the thirty minutes. Straight into it — this is the after-hours flow. Call comes in at seven, no answer at the desk, watch what happens.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Okay, so it routed to the on-call line and then texted the patient a booking link. That's the part we lose today. That's genuinely useful.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: And here's answering machine detection on the outbound side. When your recall campaign hits a voicemail, the system knows it's a machine and drops the right message instead of burning staff time.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Wait, so the detection part means my front desk isn't sitting there listening to beeps all afternoon? Because recall days are half wasted on that.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Exactly that. And the texting flow you asked about — every message goes out with consent tracking attached, so the compliance question stops being your problem.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: That texting piece with the consent baked in, that I like. My office manager will like it more.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Two things from my side then. I'll send you our SOC2 report and a TCPA one-pager for your office manager, both by Friday.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Good, send both. In exchange I'll pull our call-volume report from RingHawk so you can size this properly. I can get that to you early next week.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Deal. What worries you about actually moving?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Downtime. We cannot be down during patient hours, at all. If switching means two dead days of phones, the deal is off before it starts.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Cutover happens on a weekend, numbers port in the background, and the old system stays live until the new one answers. Nobody's phones go dark on a Tuesday.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Alright. And hypothetically, if we ever opened a sixth location next year, adding it is what, a form? Not a project?

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: A form. Same day. But let's get five working first.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Fine. Send me the two documents, I'll send the report, and then let's talk numbers.
